title: GTA6: 38 New Screenshots Reveal Vice City, Jason and Lucia
description: Rockstar Games has released 38 new screenshots of GTA6, showcasing Vice City, protagonists Jason and Lucia, and more ahead of its release later this month.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6: 38 New Screenshots Showcase Vice City, Jason, and Lucia

As the anticipation for one of the biggest entertainment launches in history reaches a fever pitch, gaming media outlet Eurogamer has reported that Rockstar Games has released 38 new screenshots for *Grand Theft Auto 6*. These images offer fans a fresh look at the game's iconic setting, its dual protagonists, and the vibrant world crafted by the development team.

### A Closer Look at Vice City and the Protagonists

The newly released batch of 38 screenshots puts a major spotlight on the returning and reimagined Vice City. From sun-drenched coastal vistas to bustling urban environments lit by neon lights, the visuals highlight the staggering detail of Rockstar's open-world design. Furthermore, protagonists Jason and Lucia are prominently featured across multiple images, giving players another glimpse into their dynamic as the game's release window approaches.

### Building Momentum Ahead of Launch

With the release slated for later this month, this substantial drop of visual material serves as a major milestone in the game's rollout. Fans and analysts alike are pouring over every detail in these 38 screenshots to glean more information about the gameplay systems, graphical fidelity, and environmental density that *GTA6* promises to deliver.

### Editor's Take

Releasing 38 fresh screenshots right before launch is a classic, highly effective move by Rockstar. It feeds the insatiable appetite of the community while underscoring the technical prowess of the title. These images reassure fans that the wait for *GTA6* and its vibrant rendition of Vice City is almost over, and the payoff looks visually stunning.
